explanation: Each group should have 500,000 users, so χ² = 2 × 2,000² / 500,000 = 16.0, which is above 10.83: a sample ratio mismatch. With very large samples, chance keeps the split very close to 50%, so even a 0.2-point drift is a warning sign. Treating small differences in group size as always fine is the common mistake, and reweighting the groups hides the cause instead of finding it.
